$comment: When to offer a way back to the newest message. Measured in screenfuls rather than messages: a message is three lines or thirty depending on what somebody said, so a count of them describes the scrollbar rather than the journey. The desktop used to offer it at a hundred pixels — about one line — which made it furniture; the phone did not offer it at all. Shared by tests/shared/present.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest.

cases.name: a line or two up is still the present
half a screen up is still a glance away
exactly a screenful is not yet past it
a screenful and a line is
a short window asks less of the reader
and a tall one asks more
a view with no height has not been laid out yet
nor has one with a negative height
past the end is not behind it
